subject.title: Improve read tool handling for binary document formats (.docx, .pdf, .pptx, .xlsx) & Avoid Token Waste on Binary Read

question: Should the read tool first fail loud for known binary document formats, or should this issue wait for broader parser/native-document work?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the issue mixes a small safe fallback with broader document parsing behavior that has security and ownership implications.

options.title: Ship safe read guard
options.body: Add a focused guard for known binary document MIME/types and point users to the PDF/document extraction paths for readable content.

options.title: Adopt or replace fork PR
options.body: Review the stale/conflicting fork PR as source work and either bring a narrow equivalent into the target repo or close it as obsolete.

options.title: Wait for document extraction design
options.body: Defer read behavior until the broader Office/provider-native document issues define parser and file-input policy.

recommendation.title: Ship safe read guard
recommendation.body: Add a focused guard for known binary document MIME/types and point users to the PDF/document extraction paths for readable content.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest routing signal for the read-tool policy and adjacent file-tool history is steipete's prior work in this area.
